title: Browser Extensions & Privacy Add-ons Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate privacy risks of your browser extensions. Evaluate permissions, sources, and security to protect your data from malicious add-ons.
description: Assess the privacy and security risks of your browser extensions based on permissions, installation sources, update frequency, and user reviews. Get personalized recommendations to improve your browser security.

inputs.helpText: Count all extensions in your browser, including disabled ones

inputs.label: Extensions from official stores (%)
inputs.helpText: Percentage installed from Chrome Web Store, Firefox Add-ons, etc.

inputs.label: Extensions with extensive permissions
inputs.helpText: Extensions that can read all website data or access sensitive info

inputs.helpText: How often your extensions receive updates from developers

inputs.helpText: Do you read user reviews and ratings before installing extensions?

inputs.label: Using reputable ad blocker
inputs.helpText: Which ad blocking solution do you use?

outputFields.label: Overall Risk Score
outputFields.description: Your browser extension security risk level (0-100)

outputFields.description: Categorized risk assessment based on your extension usage

outputFields.label: Priority Actions
outputFields.description: Number of high-priority security actions recommended

formula: let baseRisk = Math.min(extensionCount * 3, 30); let storeRisk = (100 - officialStore) * 0.4; let permissionRisk = highPermissions * 8; let updateRisk = updateFrequency === 'weekly' ? 0: updateFrequency === 'monthly' ? 5: updateFrequency === 'quarterly' ? 15: 25; let reviewBonus = reviewCheck ? -5: 0; let adBlockBonus = adBlocker === 'ublock' ? -8: adBlocker === 'adblock' ? -5: adBlocker === 'other' ? -3: 0; let riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, baseRisk + storeRisk + permissionRisk + updateRisk + reviewBonus + adBlockBonus)); let riskLevel = riskScore <= 20 ? 'Low Risk': riskScore <= 40 ? 'Moderate Risk': riskScore <= 60 ? 'High Risk': 'Critical Risk'; let recommendations = (officialStore < 90 ? 1: 0) + (highPermissions > 3 ? 1: 0) + (updateFrequency === 'rarely' ? 1: 0) + (!reviewCheck ? 1: 0) + (adBlocker === 'none' ? 1: 0); return { riskScore: Math.round(riskScore), riskLevel, recommendations };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates browser extension risks based on installation sources, permission levels, maintenance indicators, and security practices. Higher scores indicate greater privacy and security risks from potentially malicious or poorly maintained extensions.
tips: Install extensions only from official browser stores like Chrome Web Store or Firefox Add-ons
Review extension permissions carefully - avoid those requesting access to 'all website data' unless necessary
Use uBlock Origin instead of other ad blockers for better privacy and security protection
Regularly audit your extensions and remove unused ones to minimize attack surface
Consider using a privacy-focused browser for enhanced privacy alongside careful extension management

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Good extension hygiene with minimal security risks. Continue current practices.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Some areas for improvement. Review extension permissions and sources.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant security concerns. Audit extensions immediately and remove unnecessary ones.

interpretation.label: Critical Risk
interpretation.description: Serious privacy and security vulnerabilities. Immediate action required to secure browser.
